prompt_video:
Podcast-style video. Static camera, medium close-up framing locked to the start frame throughout; she keeps the exact face of the start frame. She speaks directly to someone off-camera, delivering multiple lines with very short natural pauses between them.

No captions. No background music. No camera movement or angle changes.

Realism: she looks and moves like a real woman filmed on a real podcast, never like AI: natural blinking, visible breathing, micro-expressions in her eyes, eyebrows and mouth, small head tilts and nods, hands and shoulders moving with what she feels, lips perfectly in sync with every word; real skin texture with pores, natural daylight from the side window on her face, loose hair strands that move slightly. Nothing stiff, nothing doll-like, nothing exaggerated.

She says each line exactly as written, only once, word for word, without repeating, adding, skipping or changing any word, and without "um", "uh" or "eh" that are not in the script. She must finish all three lines, including the very last words "Aguaje con fenogreco, natural.", before the clip ends; she keeps the pauses short so everything fits. After her last line she says nothing else: she stays silent, smiling, until the clip ends.

SCRIPT:

Línea 1: "Ay no, yo estaba igualita!."
Delivery: She only says her own lines, never the other person's questions or comments. Empathetic, she points at herself with one hand on her chest; quick, then straight into the next line.

Línea 2: "Hasta que mi tía me dijo: mija, primero pruebe lo natural."
Delivery: storytelling, she softly imitates her aunt's advising tone on "mija, primero pruebe lo natural", tilting her head; brief pause after it.

Línea 3: "Me pasó el Aguaje Complex 10X. Aguaje con fenogreco, natural."
Delivery: casual, like telling a friend; she says the brand name as "a-GUA-je CÓM-plex DIEZ EQUIS", with the stress on "GUA" and on "CÓM", and then, without stopping, clearly adds the second sentence "Aguaje con fenogreco, natural." word for word, ending with a small nod on "natural". The line is not finished until she says "natural".

Audio: she speaks in a natural Colombian Spanish accent from Antioquia (paisa, like a woman from Medellín: melodic rising and falling intonation, clear crisp s, warm drawn vowels at the end of phrases; never costeño, never neutral, never Mexican) at a natural, slightly brisk conversational speed, never slow, with a warm, slightly lower, slightly husky voice of a Colombian woman in her early 30s, warm and confident, like someone who's been through it; she smiles while talking so the smile can be heard, and takes small audible breaths between phrases, like a real friend talking. The voice sounds like it's coming from a close podcast mic with little echo and reverberation. As her mouth moves away from the microphone, the audio changes in volume. Soft room tone of a small podcast studio, close-mic'd podcast sound.
motivo: revision de la app: Se le quedó por fuera el final: «Aguaje con fenogreco, natural».
